entities.summary: Tiwa Savage (b. 1980-02-05, Ikeja) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Ikeja and Nigeria. Known in the fields of nigeria, composers & musicians, africa.
